# Osmos

> Osmos is a local-first, peer-to-peer version control system designed for designers, writers, and teams to privately, locally, and rapidly version and sync files. Operating entirely without central cloud servers, Osmos guarantees complete data ownership, privacy, and immediate local performance.

## Key Information & Links

- [Osmos Homepage](https://useosmos.com/): Official website and features overview.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Osmos-App): Source code, issues, and contributions.
- [Documentation](https://useosmos.com/docs/): Technical specification and user guides.
- [Download](https://useosmos.com/download/): Platform releases for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android.
- [Security Model](https://useosmos.com/security/): End-to-end encryption, local storage, and P2P synchronization architecture.
- [Open Source](https://useosmos.com/open-source/): Licensing and open-source principles.
- [Pricing](https://useosmos.com/pricing/): Open-source core and pricing details.
- [Privacy Notice](https://useosmos.com/privacy): Data handling and privacy policy.
